issues.desc: background.md uses the milestone codes M6/M7 (and index.json description additionally uses M8) as if pre-defined, but background.md never expands what M6/M7/M8 stand for inline. Line 2 says "proved the M6/M7/backfill semantics", line 5 says "the safety invariants underneath M6 and M7", and line 11 says "the M6 candidate exposure surfaces" / "the M7 structured-outcome + promotion recommendation commands" -- all treating M6/M7 as known labels. A reader of background.md alone (no prior context, not yet having read checklist.json or the external execution-plan doc) cannot resolve what M6 or M7 concretely denote until cross-referencing docs/requirements/decisions/product-capability-release-playbook-lineage-execution-plan.md, which background.md itself never links (the Ref: line only appears in index.jsons description field, not in background.md). checklist.json context fields do informally resolve this (CHK-002 prefixes M6:, CHK-003 prefixes M7:), but background.md fails the standalone-readability bar on its own.
